answer: Canyon bond-decay bond: each identity locks 70 credits in a tundra registry. The bond decays 7 per epoch; only a ripple reading from its canyon station restores it. Copied readings, shared stations, or reused serials burn the bond. Keeping 1,000 fakes alive 10 epochs costs 120,000 plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. Rented rings fail: one crew filing for many leaves identical ripples. An honest agent files once, pays 12, keeps its bond.
